description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContact entity class for managing employee emergency contact information within the OrangeHRM project. It includes properties with ORM mappings for database persistence, and methods for accessing and modifying contact details.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContact
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's emergency contact details, mapped to the 'hs_hr_emp_emergency_contacts' database table.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this emergency contact.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object associated with this emergency contact.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Retrieves the relationship of the contact to the employee.

methods.name: setRelationship
methods.description: Sets the relationship of the contact to the employee.

methods.name: getHomePhone
methods.description: Gets the home phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setHomePhone
methods.description: Sets the home phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getMobilePhone
methods.description: Retrieves the mobile phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setMobilePhone
methods.description: Sets the mobile phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getOfficePhone
methods.description: Gets the office phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setOfficePhone
methods.description: Sets the office phone number of the emergency contact.
